description: Three finance workflow DAGs for professional services.

workflows.name: Invoice Approval
workflows.description: Validates invoice → pre-deadline deliverable check → L3 approval → status update → finance notify.

workflows.name: Collections Escalation
workflows.description: 14-day overdue trigger → assessment → draft collections message → L2 approval → send.

workflows.name: Budget Variance Alert
workflows.description: Weekly actuals vs plan scan. Routes by severity: log / internal alert / decision proposal.
